versions.subject: Linux rules update
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '/curl.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -F '
        - ' --form '
        - ' --form-string '
        - ' -T '
        - ' --upload-file '
        - ' -d '
        - ' --data '
        - ' --data-' # For flags like: "--data-ascii", "--data-binary", "--data-raw", "--data-urlencode"
condition: selection

versions.subject: fix: update curl rules flags to use regex (#4213)
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '/curl'
selection_cli:
    - CommandLine|contains:
        - ' --form' # Also covers the "--form-string"
        - ' --upload-file '
        - ' --data '
        - ' --data-' # For flags like: "--data-ascii", "--data-binary", "--data-raw", "--data-urlencode"
    - CommandLine|re: '\s-[FTd]\s' # We use regex to ensure a case sensitive argument detection
filter_optional_localhost:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '://localhost'
        - '://127.0.0.1'
condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*
versions.spl: | rex field=CommandLine "(?<CommandLineMatch>\\s-[FTd]\\s)" | eval CommandLineCondition=if(isnotnull(CommandLineMatch), "true", "false") | search Image="*/curl" CommandLine IN ("* --form*", "* --upload-file *", "* --data *", "* --data-*") OR CommandLineCondition="true" NOT (CommandLine IN ("*://localhost*", "*://127.0.0.1*"))
